ownership.quote: Blacksmith The fastest way to run your GitHub Actions

stage.quote: The $10 million Series A closed in just 14 days, with Google Ventures doubling down after first backing Blacksmith's $3.5 million seed in May.
stage.note: Last priced round is a $10M Series A led by Google Ventures (Sept 2025), four months after a $3.5M seed (also led by GV, May 2025).

accelerators.name: Y Combinator
accelerators.quote: Blacksmith launched out of Y Combinator's Winter 2024 batch and today has a team of 11.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of $3.5M seed (May 2025) + $10M Series A (Sept 2025), both per TechCrunch
total_funding_usd.quote: The $10 million Series A closed in just 14 days, with Google Ventures doubling down after first backing Blacksmith's $3.5 million seed in May.

last_round.quote: Blacksmith, a Y Combinator alum, raised a $10M Series A led by Google Ventures to cut costs and speed up software builds.

revenue.basis: Company-reported figure quoted by TechCrunch (co-founder/CEO interview)
revenue.quote: Since then, revenue has reached $3.5 million ARR with more than 700 customers, supported by a team of eight, and the company is aiming to double that figure by year's end, Jayaprakash told TechCrunch.

note: YC W24 company, San Francisco-based, founded January 2024 by Aditya (JP) Jayaprakash, Aditya Maru, and Aayush Shah (ex-Faire, Cockroach Labs). Website blacksmith.sh matches the YC directory listing (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/blacksmith), confirming the hint. $1M ARR hit Feb 2025, grew to $3.5M ARR by Sept 2025 with 700+ customers; targets teams of 500+ engineers (Ashby, Chroma, Clerk, Supabase among customers).
